name: tendergrove
description: A service for making identifying distress from anecdotal evidence.

scripts.mobile:build:debug: pnpm --filter pwa build && cd pwa && (npx cap add android 2>/dev/null || true) && npx cap sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:build:ios: pnpm --filter pwa build && pnpm --dir pwa exec cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project pwa/ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath pwa/ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
